brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Configurator refuses co-location: placing drawer s on half-n at 0,0,0 (drawer:0#0,0#cut) and spike at junction [0,0,0 | 0,1,0 | 1,0,0] (socket s34) together returns SPIKE_CLASH: 'a drawer (south half) fills this corner of the junction, where the spike would stand. Take the drawer off, or use another junction.' Build left as single half-n base (piece:0,0,0;half-n) with no drawer/spike; check_build is clear.

finish.summary: Impossible in this system: the south cut face drawer occupies the exact corner volume where a spike at the same junction of that cell would stand. The live configurator enforces this as SPIKE_CLASH and offers no alternative at that junction.
